name: generate-tests-from-implementation
description: Study an implementation and generate edge case tests. Test generation task.
task: Read src/justhtml/encoding.py and understand the normalize_encoding_label function and the UTF-7 blocklist logic. Write edge case tests at tests/test_encoding_edge_cases.py covering: empty string input, whitespace-only input, blocked UTF-7 labels, case-insensitive matching, and unknown encoding labels. Use unittest or pytest style. Then run the tests with .venv/bin/pytest tests/test_encoding_edge_cases.py to verify they pass.
